parameters.jsCode:
const result = $json ?? {};

const guided = (
  Array.isArray(result.technical_assignment_sources)
  || Array.isArray(result.normative_sources)
  || Array.isArray(result.conflict_candidates)
);

return {
  json: {
    normative_sources: guided
      ? (
          Array.isArray(result.normative_sources)
            ? result.normative_sources
            : []
        )
      : (
          Array.isArray(result.sources)
            ? result.sources
            : []
        ),

    technical_assignment_sources: guided
      && Array.isArray(result.technical_assignment_sources)
        ? result.technical_assignment_sources
        : [],

    conflict_candidates: guided
      && Array.isArray(result.conflict_candidates)
        ? result.conflict_candidates
        : [],

    diagnostics: guided
      && Array.isArray(result.diagnostics)
        ? result.diagnostics
        : [],

    reference_resolutions: guided
      && Array.isArray(result.reference_resolutions)
        ? result.reference_resolutions
        : [],

    targeted_normative_sources: guided
      && Array.isArray(result.targeted_normative_sources)
        ? result.targeted_normative_sources
        : [],

    general_normative_sources: guided
      && Array.isArray(result.general_normative_sources)
        ? result.general_normative_sources
        : [],

    technical_assignment_embedding_model: guided
      ? String(result.technical_assignment_embedding_model ?? '')
      : '',

    normative_embedding_model: guided
      ? String(result.normative_embedding_model ?? '')
      : String(result.embedding_model ?? ''),

    technical_assignment_enabled: guided,
    retrieval_metrics: result.retrieval_metrics ?? null,
    retrieval_complete: result.retrieval_complete !== false,
    cancelled: result.cancelled === true,
  },
};
